staff_cost_source: U.S. BLS OEWS May 2024, 13-1111 Management Analysts, national mean hourly wage (proxy for municipal analyst review time), rounded
compute_cost_source: Local Phi-4-mini on Apple Silicon: ~15 W incremental draw × $0.13/kWh (U.S. EIA 2024 avg retail) = 0.015 kWh/h × $0.13 ≈ $0.002/hr electricity only
setup_hours_source: Student implementation log for A2 pipeline (LLMBox modes, labeling, probes, scoring, Sep 2026)
annual_volume_source: Unit = one knowledge-base record tagged (A1 corpus scale ~180 articles), not a 311 phone contact. Student estimate: ~10 record-tags per workday for KB maintenance and revisions (~2400/year). City 311 contact volume (~185k/year) is a different unit and is not used in this break-even.
manual_seconds_source: Student-measured blind labeling without API: labeling_timing.json (30 min wall clock / 100 records). Lab active-second counters are not used because they omit reading time.
